visual_brief.subject: ElevenLabs and NVIDIA name a sovereign voice-agent deployment for Poland's national e-health platform
verified_context: ElevenLabs says it added an NVIDIA multimodal model, plans 15 megawatts of NVIDIA-based compute and will use the combined stack for a sovereign voice agent on Poland's national e-health platform.
The source does not establish the agent's exact functions, language coverage, access to clinical information or measured service outcomes.
A public-health voice deployment requires explicit data boundaries, escalation paths, accessibility testing and separation between conversation and transactional authority.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: A physical voice ribbon enters a bounded sovereign chamber, passes through separated processing rooms and exits only toward a neutral public-service doorway with a visible manual handoff path.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A terracotta acoustic ribbon moves through a dark self-contained infrastructure chamber with three isolated stages, then reaches a pale civic access portal beside a separate brass escalation route.

candidate_notes.A: Rejected after comparison. The contained stages and civic portal are clear, but the display-case composition makes the deployment look more settled and observable than the source supports.
candidate_notes.B: Constitution-compliant and elegant, but the open pavilion and empty service desk weaken the sovereign-boundary question and leave the infrastructure relationship ambiguous.
candidate_notes.C: Selected. The voice coil remains inside a bounded vault with isolated stages, while the civic portal and separate escalation gate express deployment and unresolved authority without depicting patients or outcomes.

crop_review.article_desktop: The bounded voice vault, isolated processing alcoves, civic portal and separate escalation gate remain visible across the 1600×900 hero.
crop_review.article_mobile: A centered cover crop retains the sound coil, vault boundary and controlled civic channel; the separate escalation route remains visible at the lower edge.
crop_review.thumbnail: The dark circular vault, terracotta voice coil and two separate exits remain distinct at 320px.

golden_reference_comparison: The selected candidate follows the agents and orchestration references through a strong bounded runtime silhouette, restrained charcoal mass, sparse terracotta signal, tactile infrastructure depth and confident warm negative space.
